content.bridge_context: Understanding the forces that shape the Earth's surface over time.

units.title: Lithospheric Plates
units.explanation: The Earth's crust is broken into large pieces called plates that move slowly.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify a 'crack' on a boiled egg as a plate boundary. / उबले अंडे की 'दरार' को प्लेट सीमा के रूप में पहचानें।

units.title: Endogenic and Exogenic Forces
units.explanation: Endogenic: Internal forces (Earthquakes, Volcanoes). Exogenic: External forces (Wind, Water, Ice).
units.dual_language_instruction: Is a river an internal or external force? / क्या नदी एक आंतरिक बल है या बाहरी?
